folds.note: the probe uses ONLY the TRAIN side of fold 0 (initial block); the frame is cut to it before any feature is built, so no later-fold bar is ever held. Later folds are reachable only through alpha.families.gate.survival_gate (not called here).

sizing.note: normalised research account (V1 DEFAULT_SIZING for GER40); costs/sizing per market from alpha.common.market_costs; window = the family spec's effective window on the market's LOCAL calendar

null.note: day-shifted-label null: candidates re-mapped to the same clock bar s days later (circular over Train days), stop/target distances kept; best-of-grid statistic per shift
